title: [vtc] end_cascade skips breakout rooms the caller cannot access
description: Found in review of JMAP-8mem.5. end_cascade (crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/call.rs) collects breakout rooms through caller-scoped get_objects. Under VtcBackend §Per-call access, a room the ending moderator cannot access is left out, so it is never ended when the parent ends (jmap-vtc-implementer-guide §Breakout room cleanup: 'Implement parent-call end as a cascade that ends all child calls first'). Fix likely means moving the cascade into the backend, or adding an access-agnostic room read and write path. Add a test with deny_call_access on a breakout room.
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
